game.name: Quantum Pong
game.desc: Pong, but gates warp the ball: split it in two, bounce it off a wall, or teleport and reverse it.

game.name: Qlimbers
game.desc: Race a rival to the top of your tower by matching each floor's target qubit state before they do.

game.name: Pauli Invaders
game.desc: Retro meets quantum error correction: only the matching color code clears an invader.

game.name: Ion Surfer
game.desc: Shape the trap potential to keep your ion riding the wave.

game.name: Superconductor
game.desc: Route two-qubit gates across a superconducting chip before they decohere. Solo, co-op or versus.

game.name: Overquqed
game.desc: Co-op quantum kitchen: prepare |0>, |+>, Bell pairs and cat states with gate appliances, and serve them before they decohere.

game.name: Qurves
game.desc: Light cycles in superposition: split into mirrored copies and survive as long as one of them does. For 2 or 4 players.

game.name: Gate Drop
game.desc: Quantum circuit puzzle for 1 or 2 players: drop gate pills onto the qubit wires, cancel each gate with its inverse, and clear every Pauli error.

game.name: Planck Time
game.desc: Quantum microgame party for 1 or 2 players: twelve five-second games, one verb each, faster and faster. Align a qubit, cancel a gate, measure, sort, shield, connect... before the fuse burns out.

game.name: Brawl-Ket
game.desc: Two-player fighting game where every fighter is in a quantum basis, shown by their colour: green attacks (X) only hurt green fighters, purple attacks (Z) only purple ones, throws (Y) hurt both, and Y switches your colour (a Hadamard).

game.name: Qarrera
game.desc: Slot-car racing on the four wires of a quantum circuit, for 1 to 4 players and computer racers: pick your speed and your wire, grab the gates, and lead the pack. Every second in front counts.

game.name: Gate Prix
game.desc: Kart racing through a dilution fridge, for 1 or 2 players against computer racers: steer through the glowing gate to build the target quantum circuit. Every right gate is a boost, and the CIRCUIT CHECK before the final lap pays out for a perfect circuit.
